headline: Executive order pulls the US out of certain United Nations groups, ends funding to some, and orders a review of all international organizations.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order withdraws the United States from certain United Nations organizations and stops US funding to some of them. It also calls for a review of US support for all international organizations. The title does not say which organizations are affected or what the review might lead to.

who_it_affects.how: They would lose US membership and US funding, though the title does not name which ones.

who_it_affects.group: Other international organizations the US belongs to or funds
who_it_affects.how: Their US support would be reviewed, which could lead to later changes.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that handle foreign affairs, such as the State Department
who_it_affects.how: They would likely carry out the withdrawals, stop the payments, and conduct the review.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed February 4, 2025; the title does not give other dates or deadlines.
